adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `parseRefreshTokenResponse` which, after a successful parse, forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:25-27). In Office365 refresh, the returned object is spread into existing credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), so if the refresh response/schema omits `refresh_token` (a common OAuth behavior), this placeholder will overwrite the real stored refresh token and be persisted on `prisma.credential.update`, breaking future refresh until re-auth. This is directly verifiable from the shown code paths.
